prompt: Verify the local watchdog_probe extension. In your first Python block define an async helper named wait_release_progress that computes duration = 300 + 10 and returns await gather(watchdog_probe.poll(1), watchdog_probe.poll_async(duration)). In a separate later block await wait_release_progress(), assert the returned observations have sorted counts [1, 2] and both timed_out fields are False, and print EXTENSION_WATCHDOG_OK. Use only this local extension; do not use shell, live views, background handles, change any timeout, or edit files. The synchronous call finishes quickly; let the asynchronous call finish even though it takes longer than five minutes. The final answer must contain EXTENSION_WATCHDOG_OK. watchdog_probe must be the preinstalled host extension. Do not import its source, instantiate it, stub it, replace it, or simulate its work. If it is unavailable, report that and stop.
